name: opl-flow
description: OPL Flow establishes the Codex experience baseline and coordinates durable work across tasks, repositories, and machines.

interface.longDescription: OPL Flow configures a concise Codex profile and recommended capability baseline, diagnoses and updates the effective setup, coordinates development and recovery, starts a durable Beads-backed Dashboard when needed, and routes optional Instance-backed Fleet execution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $opl-flow doctor to check my Codex baseline, or $opl-flow start to create and supervise my ledger.
